verdict.rationale: Mistral's own built-in agent tools let models analyze user data inside the platform: Code Interpreter runs data analysis and graphing, and Document Library adds RAG over uploaded documents. This is documented mainly as Agents API tooling, not as a turnkey in-product insights or suggestions experience, and there is no hands-on corroboration. Missing for 10: an explicit in-product insights/suggestions feature over user data, documentation of the end-user (Le Chat) workflow, independent or hands-on evidence of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Code Interpreter enables safe, on-demand code execution for data analysis, graphing, and more in isolated containers
Document Library enhances agents with uploaded documents via Mistral Cloud's built-in RAG tool
AI agents autonomously execute tasks using LLMs, with tools, state persistence, and multi-agent collaboration via the Agents API
